title: Promote CH-benCHmark native full-run evidence to independent benchmark gate coverage

steps.step: Inspect current CH-benCHmark native smoke artifacts and bench_gate integration
Confirm latest CH-benCHmark evidence is a full create/load/execute BenchBase run
Add CH-benCHmark native report discovery and explicit report input to bench_gate.py
Extract CH-benCHmark native checks into a reusable evaluator independent of external_smoke_summary.json
Verify explicit report, run-root discovery, strict profile discovery, and combined independent gate paths
Record evidence conservatively as native full-run smoke, not long-duration HTAP production certification

verification: python -m py_compile bench_gate.py chbenchmark_native_smoke.py tsbs_official_runner_smoke.py ldbc_snb_complex_matrix.py: passed
python -m json.tool gate_profiles/production_medium.json and production_medium_strict_native.json: passed
python bench_gate.py ... without --chbenchmark-native-report: passed 28/28 via discovery
python bench_gate.py --gate-profile production_medium_strict_native.json ...: passed 28/28 via discovery
python bench_gate.py ... with independent LDBC matrix + TSBS official runner + CH-benCHmark native: passed 43/43
python bench_gate.py --gate-profile production_medium_strict_native.json ... with independent LDBC matrix + TSBS official runner + CH-benCHmark native: passed 43/43

remaining_blockers: This gate integration covers CH-benCHmark native full-run smoke only, not a long-duration HTAP production certification.
The observed latest workload completed only a short duration=10 run and sampled a small transaction mix.
Broader CH-benCHmark query coverage, longer mixed workload duration, and recovery/compaction interactions remain future production-readiness work.
Native memtier remains blocked until a real memtier_benchmark binary is available.
Full official LDBC mixed workload/update coverage remains separate from the command-mode isolation matrix.
next_task: BENCHPROD-119 candidate: move native memtier from blocked to runnable by installing/building a real memtier_benchmark, or deepen CH-benCHmark with a query-class matrix.
